title: Lifecycle
subtitle: fetch → keep → update → validate → persist → save → feedback
description: Map each production form stage to the Resource API.

callouts.title: Alpha coverage
callouts.content: The happy path is implemented. See Alpha Limitations for concurrency, server errors, offline queue, and SSR gaps.

content: This page is the checklist for wiring a production-style form against qortex-resource.

sections.title: 2. Keep (source update policy)
sections.content: When source data changes while the user has edits, choose how drafts behave:

code.code:
// default: keepDirty — preserve overrides when source refreshes
sourceUpdate: 'keepDirty' | 'resetDraft' | 'replaceAll'

sections.title: 4. Validate
sections.content: `validate.on`: change | blur | submit | manual. Field validators and/or `zodResolver`. `save()` always validates first.

sections.title: 6. Save
sections.content: `source.save(draft, meta)` with `meta.changedFields`. Optional `mutation.optimistic`. Hooks: `onSaveSuccess`, `onSaveError`. Mutation API: `isSaving`, `mutation.status`, `retry()`, `reset()`.

sections.title: 7. Feedback
sections.content: Drive UI from snapshot flags — no built-in toasts. Bind `isLoading` / `isSaving` / `error` / `mutation.error` / `isValid` / `errors` to your design system.
